entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's a fault. The cadence numbers are just... wrong. They're all over the place. Honestly, the thing is a piece of garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the readings. We can definitely try some troubleshooting steps to see if we can get it calibrated for you.
Oh, no... I really don't have time for all that. I've been a loyal customer for years and I just expected it to work. I just want my money back, please.
I understand completely. You just want a product that works right out of the box. Let me pull up your account and our policy.
Thank you. I was really counting on this, and I'm just so disappointed. I really need the refund.

Okay, one moment... I see your account here, and thank you for being a VIP member with us for so long. I see you received the band 19 days ago. Let me just check the policy... Yes, the VeloBand Cadence Sensor is covered by our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that refund for you, no problem at all.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much.

Of course. I've just authorized the return. I'm sending the pre-paid shipping label to your email now. Just send the item back in its original box, and you'll see the full amount back on your card within 5-7 business days after we receive it. For the inconvenience, and as a thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account.
Wow, I wasn't expecting that. Thank you, Diana. I really appreciate you making this so easy.
It's my pleasure. We want to make sure you're taken care of. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
